paragraphs: Gravity is the platform public agencies use to manage budgeting, automate financial reporting, and meet compliance requirements. Local governments use it to automate budgeting, annual comprehensive financial reports, grants, and transparency work.

One platform covers grants, budgets, disclosures, and transparency. Every number connects back to its source, so a single update carries everywhere it appears. Annual reports, popular annual financial reports, and budget books are built on that traceable data. Lease and debt tools automate GASB 87, 88, and 96 disclosures, amortizations, and audit preparation. The company says it integrates with Tyler, Munis, Oracle, JD Edwards, and more.

More than 230 public agencies in over 40 states use the platform, according to the about page. ClearGov and Gravity have joined forces on public sector finance. Leadership is described as a team with deep experience in government finance, product design, and customer success. A library of case studies collects accounts of financial reporting and compliance projects.

quote.text: Empowering all governments to transparently engage with citizens.
